seasonal.title: The month the oven is fully booked
seasonal.body: For four weeks a year, counter space is the scarcest thing in the kitchen and the oven has a queue. That is the fortnight when a second cooking box and a probe that reports from inside the meat stop being gadgets and start being logistics.
